items.title: Klook Withdraws U.S. IPO, Citing Market Conditions
items.summary: Klook may have pulled its IPO, but the pitch hasn’t changed. Experiences are still one of the least digitized parts of travel, and that’s a lot of runway. The catch? Viator, GetYourGuide and the OTAs know it too, and Klook needs to move fast before they close the gap.

items.title: UK’s India Growth Plan Means Getting Travelers Out of London
items.summary: The UK may not need to win many more Indian travelers so much as encourage the ones it gets already beyond London. With 94% of direct seats landing in the capital, a $2 billion visitor-spend target by 2030 will depend on regional flights and bookable itineraries.

items.title: Airlines Can’t Upgrade Every Plane – So They’re Upgrading the Menu
items.summary: New cabins are expensive, complicated, and slow to arrive. Celebrity chefs? A faster way to serve up an upscale experience — and help justify the premium fare.

items.title: Western Europe Drives Another Drop in Overseas Travel to the U.S.
items.summary: Gains from China and South America haven’t been enough to make up for declines in travel from Western Europe.

items.title: AI Travel Advice Is Less Personal Than It Seems
items.summary: For now, AI personalizes the message, but it doesn't personalize the recommendation.
